verdict.rationale: Fly.io's only first-party route to natural-language operation is an experimental flyctl MCP server, which lets an AI agent drive flyctl so users can operate the platform conversationally through an MCP client. The evidence is a single thin doc line, and nothing shows a native natural-language interface; Sprites and Machines describe hosting agents, not operating Fly.io by natural language. Missing for 10: a native or documented natural-language command interface, stable (non-experimental) MCP support, documentation of which operations are exposed, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
